exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to report, to announce (to notify formally)
to put, to lay, to place
to rely on, to pin one's hopes on, to bank on
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: приложи́ть — to put (next to); доложи́ть — to report, to announce (to notify formally); заложи́ть — to put, to lay, to place; полага́ться — to rely on, to pin one's hopes on, to bank on.
**полагаюсь** — полага́ться (imperfective): to rely on, to pin one's hopes on, to bank on; to be due to, be entitled to; to be proper, to be in order, to be expected. Wiktionary: полага́ть + -ся.
